definitions.explanation: A fish of the tuna family, important in Japanese cuisine both fresh (as sashimi/tataki) and dried (as katsuobushi, the base for dashi).

examples.japanese: {鰹|かつお}のたたきが{大好|だいす}きだ。
{鰹節|かつおぶし}で{出汁|だし}を{取|と}る。
examples.english: To make dashi stock from dried bonito flakes.

examples.japanese: {初|はつ}ガツオは{春|はる}の{味覚|みかく}だ。
examples.english: The first bonito catch is a taste of spring.
examples.notes: {初|はつ}ガツオ refers to bonito caught in spring migration

notes:
CULINARY USES:
{鰹|かつお} is central to Japanese cuisine in multiple forms:
・{刺身|さしみ} (sashimi - raw)
・たたき (tataki - seared)
・{鰹節|かつおぶし} (dried bonito flakes - essential for dashi)

SEASONAL VARIETIES:
・{初|はつ}ガツオ (spring catch - lean, refreshing)
・{戻|もど}りガツオ (autumn catch - fatty, rich)

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{鰹|かつお}の{刺身|さしみ} (bonito sashimi)
・{鰹|かつお}のたたき (seared bonito)
・{鰹節|かつおぶし}を{削|けず}る (shave dried bonito)

REGIONAL NOTE:
Kochi Prefecture ({高知県|こうちけん}) is famous for {鰹|かつお}のたたき.
